cases.question: 库里在 2023-24 常规赛对掘金累计得分和出场次数？
cases.oracle_sql: SELECT SUM(p.points) AS points_total, COUNT(*) AS games_appeared FROM player_game_stat p JOIN game g ON g.game_id=p.game_id WHERE p.person_id='201939' AND p.opponent_team_id='1610612743' AND g.season_id='2023-24' AND g.competition_phase='regular_season' AND p.appearance_status IN ('played','played_inferred')
